question.problem: Nazareth is doing an experiment in her Chemistry class. She heated a liquid whose initial temperature was $-5.6^{\circ} \, \textrm{C}.$ After several minutes, the temperature of the liquid rose by $4.7^{\circ} \, \textrm{C},$ at which point she decided to end the experiment. What was the final temperature of the liquid?
question.worked_solution:
To determine the final temperature of the liquid, we add the change in temperature to the initial temperature of the liquid. This gives

$$
-5.6^{\circ}\,\textrm{C} + 4.7^{\circ}\,\textrm{C} = -0.9^{\circ}\,\textrm{C}.
$$

Therefore, the temperature of the liquid at the end of the experiment was $-0.9^{\circ}\,\textrm{C}.$
